contentExpectations: Select exactly 5 AI-focused companies from the YC Winter 2024 (W24) batch.
Include one row for every founder of each of the 5 selected companies (all co-founders represented, not just one per company).
Each cold_outreach_email must be personalized to the specific founder and their specific company, referencing details relevant to that founder/company.
Each cold_outreach_email must explicitly request a 15-minute call.
linkedin_url should be the founder's individual LinkedIn profile URL.
